title: Implement Contact section variants (contact-form, contact-details)
description: Implement two Contact section variants. contact-form shows a contact form with name/email/message fields alongside business contact details. contact-details shows only business contact info (phone, email, address) in a formatted layout without a form.
acceptanceCriteria: Both accept `{ content: ContactContent, business: BusinessInfo }` props
ContactForm renders a form with name, email, message fields and submit button
ContactDetails renders phone, email, address in a clean layout
Form shows section id='contact' for anchor link navigation
Phone number is a clickable `<a href='tel:...'>` link
Email is a clickable `<a href='mailto:...'>` link
Verify in browser with Playwright screenshot

steps.details: Section with `id='contact'`. Two-column layout: left side has form (name, email, message textarea, submit button), right side has contact details (phone, email, address). Form is presentational only in the exported site — no actual form submission needed for the demo.

Section with `id='contact'`. Single column or two-column. Show: phone (`<a href='tel:...'>`), email (`<a href='mailto:...'>`), address, business hours if available. Icons for each contact method using Lucide React.
Take Playwright screenshot. Verify phone and email are clickable links. Verify form fields render correctly.
